annotations.title: Write a manual crew (a group of wallets you suspect move together)

description: Create or change YOUR manual crew `m-<id>`: a roster of Solana wallets the desk then follows as one group — their fills land as crew_buy / crew_sell events under that id, the token row and the momentum feed count them under crews.*, and a strategy can name the crew (`{f: "crews.ids", op: "in", v: ["m-<id>"]}`). mode: replace (default) · add · remove wallets; active false parks it. A wallet is in one crew at a time — a manual crew first. action: 'remove' deletes the crew. Signed-in; a rig step on our door writes as its runner.

active.description: false parks the crew (no fills counted) without deleting it.

id.description: Your crew's slug (2–32 of a-z, 0-9, -); served as m-<id>.

mode.description: How wallets meet the current roster (default replace).

name: desk_crew_set
